attributes.name: Wooden Shield
attributes.powers:
If you played a weapon that has the 2-Handed trait on this check, you may not play this card.

Recharge this card to reduce Combat damage dealt to you by 2. If you are proficient with light armors, you may play another armor on this check.

corrections.corrected_text: On the armor Arrow Catching Studded Leather, replace the first two powers with the following:"Recharge this card to reduce Combat damage dealt to you by 1, or 3 if it is also Ranged Combat damage."
